message.text: Review policy and standards changed in this revision.

explanation.what: This revision changes AGENTS.md, which steers how Melian reviews this repository.
explanation.whatToDo: Have a maintainer read the change to AGENTS.md before merging.
explanation.whyHere: Melian reviewed the revision under the policy and standards it changes, so nothing it ran judged the new ones.

snippet.text: The first reviewed head, 268c96a02, wrote down five delegations. Codex's review, the review of record and two Melian rounds found each of three resting on an agent's judgement and contradicting an active decision; the fixes in 5e8689332, bd0d35dfa, c8dd4d3d8 and b9e2ebd41 narrowed them and the second round found new holes of the same class. The maintainer then chose to keep two and withdraw three.
